comparison.objective: Play four even C-chord downstrokes, change to A minor, and play four more.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise fretting pressure, coordinated sequential string plucking, chord transition, and rhythmic timing.
comparison.success_condition: Eight ordered strums produce the correct ringing pitches, string order, and beat regularity without excessive string displacement.
comparison.reason: This is timed musical actuation of tensioned strings. It shares no task-defining physical ability with aperture-based many-body separation.
